title: Impact of trifluoromethyl Ugi adducts as anticancer agents: EGFR inhibition, apoptosis induction and miRNA up-regulation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,19530-19545
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01428J, Paper

Mohammed Salah Ayoup, Eman Mamdouh, Saied M. Soliman, Ibrahim Elghamry, Mohamed S. Nafie, Amr Negm, Amr Sonousi, Asmaa E. Kassab, Laila F. Awad
A series of novel bis-amide Ugi adducts with a Y-shaped configuration imitating the thematic feature of fourth-generation EGFR inhibitors was designed and synthesized with potent cytotoxicity against breast and lung cancer cells.
